title: Resolution urging Albany to expand and raise the bottle deposit
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.237-B, the 'Bigger Better Bottle Bill,' which would expand the state's bottle deposit law to cover wine, liquor and certain non-carbonated beverages and raise the deposit from 5 cents to 10 cents. The Council argues this would boost recycling rates, reduce litter and plastic pollution, and ease costs for municipal recycling programs.
